digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge CLI, engine, and reconciliation vocabulary
propositions: Canonical preview/sync routes must be primary while legacy reconcile/--mode adapters remain callable with preserved documented defaults and numeric results
Legacy --filter-local-ids retains post-differ write filtering; canonical --only/--except narrow differ inputs before execution
Direct-engine and argument-less live defaults remain functional and normalize into the same core execution path as canonical requests
Max-changes applies deterministic applied/deferred manifests for capped live; uncapped live retains prior behavior and temporary manifest deletion
--only/--except tokens must resolve to existing local IDs or Jira keys before lock acquisition; unresolved input exits 2 without lock or mutation
Production workflow maps rollback settings to canonical vocabulary while preserving lock-free reconcile-check diagnostic path for existing checked-out revisions
